description: Encrypt a value locally and store it in an environment. A value may reference another secret as ${OTHER_SECRET}: the reference is stored literally and expanded whenever the secret is read, so it tracks the referenced value. Write $${OTHER_SECRET} for a literal.

app.description: application slug or id (or set via configure_project)

env.description: environment slug or id (a service token infers its own)

group.description: target a group environment instead of an app

org.description: organization slug or id (defaults to a lone org)

name: set_secret
